proposed_widenings.name: redirect_incoming_attack_target
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's curse deterministically changes who a ranged-weapon attack targets. The current surface can encode the resistance rider honestly, but it has no atom or subgraph for forced target substitution on an already-declared incoming attack.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever an attack with a Ranged weapon targets a creature within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.

notes: Passive magic-item family fits the resistance half with condition=holding_item and grant_resistance filtered to ranged-weapon attacks, but the curse is a real mechanical rider and cannot be omitted honestly. No content/.dhall or trace file was authored.
